import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '.')
import pandas as pd
from temp_module import calculate_totals

def test_totals():
    df = pd.DataFrame({
        'category': ['A', 'A', 'B'],
        'value': [10, 20, 15]
    })
    result = calculate_totals(df, 'category', 'value')
    assert result['A'] == 30
    assert result['B'] == 15
